title: Modal dialog with focus management and validation
prompt: Show a "New project" button. It opens a modal dialog titled "Create project" with a "Project name" field, a "Cancel" button and a "Create" button. The Project name field has focus when the dialog opens. While the dialog is open, Tab and Shift+Tab keep focus inside it. Create with an empty name shows the error "Enter a project name" and keeps the dialog open. Create with a name closes the dialog, adds the name to a list of projects on the page, and moves focus back to the "New project" button. Cancel or the Escape key closes the dialog without adding anything.
